                OR (NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(s.name, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bad
      FROM staff s
     WHERE s.org_id = $1::uuid AND COALESCE(s.status, 'active') = 'active' AND s.role IS NOT NULL AND s.role NOT IN ('client', 'affiliate', 'partner') AND COALESCE(s.is_demo, false) = false
  UNION ALL
    SELECT CASE WHEN (sh.started_at < now() - interval '24 hour')
                OR (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM staff s WHERE s.id = sh.staff_id AND s.org_id = sh.org_id)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bad
      FROM shifts sh
     WHERE sh.org_id = $1::uuid AND sh.ended_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(sh.is_demo, false) = false
  UNION ALL
    SELECT CASE WHEN (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM staff s WHERE s.id = e.staff_id AND s.org_id = e.org_id))
                OR (NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(e.kind, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bad
      FROM staff_events e

contract.control: Summary tiles: SHORT BY, WAITING ON YOU, ON THE BENCH, OPEN APPLICATIONS + bench chip
contract.requirement: Every active hiring role the tiles add up must show the open applications and the bench people a recount of its own applications gives, with its short-by number its target minus that bench and never below zero; every open application must sit in a stage where a person is still being considered and belong to an active role, so the open number cannot count someone who is no longer open or leave someone out. WAITING ON YOU is read from the candidates list and is judged by the page test, not here.
contract.sql:
/* display-result:hiring-bench-tiles */
SELECT count(*)::int AS sample_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.bad = 1)::int AS bad_count
  FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN (b.open_applications <> (SELECT count(*) FROM candidate_applications a WHERE a.role_id = b.role_id AND a.status = 'open'))
                OR (b.bench_count <> (SELECT count(*) FROM candidate_applications a JOIN pipeline_stages s ON s.id = a.stage_id
                 WHERE a.role_id = b.role_id AND a.status = 'open' AND s.key IN ('one_on_one', 'offer')))
                OR (b.bench_shortfall <> CASE WHEN b.bench_target - (SELECT count(*) FROM candidate_applications a JOIN pipeline_stages s ON s.id = a.stage_id
                 WHERE a.role_id = b.role_id AND a.status = 'open' AND s.key IN ('one_on_one', 'offer')) > 0 THEN b.bench_target - (SELECT count(*) FROM candidate_applications a JOIN pipeline_stages s ON s.id = a.stage_id
                 WHERE a.role_id = b.role_id AND a.status = 'open' AND s.key IN ('one_on_one', 'offer')) ELSE 0 END) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bad
      FROM v_hiring_bench b
     WHERE b.org_id = $1::uuid
  UNION ALL
    SELECT CASE WHEN (s.key NOT IN ('applied', 'screening', 'group_interview', 'one_on_one', 'offer'))
                OR (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_roles r WHERE r.id = a.role_id AND r.active = true)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bad
      FROM candidate_applications a
      JOIN pipeline_stages s ON s.id = a.stage_id
      JOIN candidates c ON c.id = a.candidate_id
     WHERE a.org_id = $1::uuid AND a.status = 'open'
      AND COALESCE(c.is_demo, false) = false
      AND COALESCE(c.source_detail, '') <> 'platform_demo'
      AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(c.full_name, ''), 1, 5) NOT IN ('DEMO ', 'DEMO-', 'DEMO—')
  ) r

What the table PAINTS is judged by fin-b12-repair-hiring.test.mjs.
contract.sql:
/* display-result:hiring-bench */
SELECT count(*)::int AS sample_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.bad = 1)::int AS bad_count

                              WHERE a.role_id = b.role_id AND a.status = 'open' AND s.key IN ('one_on_one', 'offer')))
                OR (b.bench_shortfall <> CASE WHEN b.bench_target - b.bench_count > 0 THEN b.bench_target - b.bench_count ELSE 0 END)

      FROM v_hiring_bench b
     WHERE b.org_id = $1::uuid

                OR (NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(r.name, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bad

contract.control: Ideas: month spend meter (used of cap)
contract.requirement: Every model call saved this month must carry its price when the price is on file: each of the three priced models (claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-code) must be saved with a cost, that cost must equal its tokens at the model's price plus a cent for each web search (claude-code costs nothing), because the meter adds these costs up and counts an unknown cost at the worst-case rate.
contract.sql:
/* display-result:mkt-month-meter */
SELECT count(*)::int AS sample_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.bad = 1)::int AS bad_count
  FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN (u.model IN ('claude-opus-5-5', 'claude-sonnet-5-5', 'claude-code') AND u.cost_usd IS NULL)
                OR ((u.model = 'claude-opus-5-5' AND u.cost_usd IS NOT NULL AND ABS(u.cost_usd - ((u.input_tokens * 4 + u.output_tokens * 20 + u.cache_read_tokens * 0.2 + u.cache_write_tokens * 5) / 1000000.0 + u.web_search_requests * 0.01)) > 0.00001)
                OR (u.model = 'claude-sonnet-5-5' AND u.cost_usd IS NOT NULL AND ABS(u.cost_usd - ((u.input_tokens * 2 + u.output_tokens * 10 + u.cache_read_tokens * 0.2 + u.cache_write_tokens * 2.5) / 1000000.0 + u.web_search_requests * 0.01)) > 0.00001)
                OR (u.model = 'claude-code' AND u.cost_usd IS NOT NULL AND u.cost_usd <> 0)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bad
      FROM marketing_model_usage u
     WHERE u.org_id = $1::uuid AND u.created_at >= now() - interval '35 days'
  ) r

         AND (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(u.cost_usd), 0) FROM marketing_model_usage u WHERE u.org_id = j.org_id AND u.job_id = j.id)
             > 2 * CAST(j.payload->>'max_cost_usd' AS numeric))

             OR NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p.page_copy->>'lede', '')), '') IS NULL

                OR (f.tag IS NULL OR strpos(substr(p.html, 1, strpos(p.html, '</head>')), '<meta name="fh-funnel-tag" content="' || f.tag || '">') = 0)

contract.requirement: Every funnel's script mix must use only the six script kinds with numbers of zero or more, its default ad set must belong to one of its own Meta campaigns, and no Meta campaign may sit on two funnels (read from the funnels' own campaign lists, so a campaign that is not synced yet still counts). contract.sql:
/* display-result:mkt-settings-funnel-card */
SELECT count(*)::int AS sample_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.bad = 1)::int AS bad_count

                OR (f.default_ad_set_external_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (

                OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM marketing_funnels g
                  WHERE g.org_id = f.org_id AND g.id <> f.id
                    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(f.meta_campaign_ids) AS cid WHERE cid = ANY(g.meta_campaign_ids)))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bad

contract.requirement: Every case that was sent through the drawer must keep what the send options said, both ways: an Experian portal upload names an Experian case, keeps the reference, logs a portal attempt and moves the case on, and a logged portal upload has its reference on the case; a mailed letter keeps its provider id, logs a letter attempt and moves the case on, a letter logged as sent has its provider id on the case, and a failed mail is not left failed. The Mail service choice is sent to the mail provider and saved nowhere, so only the page's request is judged for it, by the page test.
contract.sql:
/* display-result:specialist-send-options */
SELECT count(*)::int AS sample_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.bad = 1)::int AS bad_count
  FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN (UPPER(BTRIM(COALESCE(k.selected_bureaus_raw, ''))) <> 'EX')
                OR (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inquiry_attempts t JOIN inquiry_log l ON l.id = t.inquiry_id
              WHERE COALESCE(l.inquiry_removal_case_id, l.case_id) = k.id AND t.kind = 'portal'))
                OR (k.case_status::text IN ('Queued', 'Blocked')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bad
      FROM inquiry_removal_cases k
     WHERE k.org_id = $1::uuid AND COALESCE(k.is_demo, false) = false AND NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(k.portal_confirmation, '')), '') IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
    SELECT CASE WHEN (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inquiry_attempts t JOIN inquiry_log l ON l.id = t.inquiry_id
              WHERE COALESCE(l.inquiry_removal_case_id, l.case_id) = k.id AND t.kind = 'letter'))
                OR (k.case_status::text IN ('Queued', 'Blocked')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bad
      FROM inquiry_removal_cases k
     WHERE k.org_id = $1::uuid AND COALESCE(k.is_demo, false) = false AND NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(k.letter_provider_id, '')), '') IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
    SELECT CASE WHEN (NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(k.portal_confirmation, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bad
      FROM inquiry_attempts t
      JOIN inquiry_log l ON l.id = t.inquiry_id
      JOIN inquiry_removal_cases k ON k.id = COALESCE(l.inquiry_removal_case_id, l.case_id)
     WHERE t.org_id = $1::uuid AND COALESCE(k.is_demo, false) = false AND t.kind = 'portal'
      AND LOWER(COALESCE(t.outcome, '')) = 'uploaded' AND LOWER(COALESCE(t.note, '')) LIKE 'experian_ref:%'
  UNION ALL
    SELECT CASE WHEN (NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(k.letter_provider_id, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bad
      FROM inquiry_attempts t
      JOIN inquiry_log l ON l.id = t.inquiry_id
      JOIN inquiry_removal_cases k ON k.id = COALESCE(l.inquiry_removal_case_id, l.case_id)
     WHERE t.org_id = $1::uuid AND COALESCE(k.is_demo, false) = false AND t.kind = 'letter'
      AND LOWER(COALESCE(t.outcome, '')) = 'sent'
  UNION ALL
    SELECT CASE WHEN (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inquiry_attempts u WHERE u.inquiry_id = t.inquiry_id AND u.kind = 'letter'
                AND u.created_at > t.created_at AND LOWER(COALESCE(u.outcome, '')) NOT LIKE 'mail_failed%')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bad
      FROM inquiry_attempts t
      JOIN inquiry_log l ON l.id = t.inquiry_id
     WHERE t.org_id = $1::uuid AND COALESCE(l.is_demo, false) = false AND t.kind = 'letter'
      AND LOWER(COALESCE(t.outcome, '')) LIKE 'mail_failed%'
  ) r

contract.requirement: Every bureau call placed in the last 30 days must have, for that client, a number-reveal log entry and a case stamped as fired, each within five minutes of the call itself. A second launch on a case that was already stamped (the button is disabled by the page only, the server does not refuse it) has no new stamp and is seen, and so is a call whose case was never stamped; a case the scheduler stamped without placing a call does not answer for a call. contract.control: 'Needs a human read' list: low-confidence bureau answers and stuck clients; 'Mark as checked' button
contract.requirement: Every bureau answer that needed a person (no confidence at all, low confidence, or held for escalation) and is marked checked must carry the confirm time and a staff member in the same company who confirmed it; every answer a person confirmed must have the confirm record the button writes (a parse.confirmed entry for that client and case, written within five minutes of the confirm, naming that same person), so a flag flipped with nothing advanced is seen; no bureau answer on a real client may sit unchecked past the repair program's own 24 hour clock, which is how a list that hides an answer shows up; and no real client's repair card may sit on the Stalled stage past that same 24 hour human-read clock (the program sets no clock for Stalled, so this is the one it has), because the list exists so a person moves it.
contract.sql:
/* display-result:repair-parse-confirmed */
SELECT count(*)::int AS sample_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.bad)::int AS bad_count
  FROM (
  SELECT ((r.confirmed_at IS NULL)
         OR (r.confirmed_by IS NULL)
         OR (s.id IS NULL)) AS bad
  FROM dispute_responses r
  LEFT JOIN staff s ON (s.id = r.confirmed_by) AND (s.org_id = r.org_id)
 WHERE r.org_id = $1::uuid
   AND (r.confirmed = true) AND ((r.confidence IS NULL)
         OR (COALESCE(r.confidence < 0.85, false))
         OR (r.parse_json->>'heldForEscalation' = 'true'))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT (COALESCE(r.created_at < now() - interval '1440 minutes', false)) AS bad
  FROM dispute_responses r
  LEFT JOIN clients k ON (k.id = r.client_id) AND (k.org_id = r.org_id)
 WHERE r.org_id = $1::uuid
   AND (r.confirmed IS DISTINCT FROM true) AND (k.is_demo IS NOT TRUE)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM repair_decision_log l WHERE (l.org_id = r.org_id) AND (l.client_id = r.client_id) AND (l.case_id = r.case_id) AND (l.decision = 'parse.confirmed') AND (lower(btrim(l.payload->>'confirmedBy')) = lower(btrim(r.confirmed_by::text))) AND (COALESCE(l.created_at >= r.confirmed_at - interval '5 minutes' AND l.created_at <= r.confirmed_at + interval '5 minutes', false)))) AS bad
  FROM dispute_responses r
 WHERE r.org_id = $1::uuid
   AND (r.confirmed = true) AND (r.confirmed_by IS NOT NULL)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT (COALESCE(ca.updated_at < now() - interval '1440 minutes', false)) AS bad
  FROM cards ca
  LEFT JOIN pipeline_stages ps ON ps.id = ca.stage_id
  LEFT JOIN pipelines p ON (p.id = ca.pipeline_id) AND (p.key = 'optimization')
  LEFT JOIN clients k ON (k.id = ca.client_id) AND (k.org_id = ca.org_id)
 WHERE ca.org_id = $1::uuid
   AND (ca.is_demo IS NOT TRUE) AND (k.is_demo IS NOT TRUE) AND (p.id IS NOT NULL) AND (ps.key = 'stalled')
  ) x

contract.control: Post states legend: Draft, Waiting, Sending now, Sent, Could not be sent, Needs a rewrite (plus Held for approval)
contract.requirement: Every post of the last 180 days must be the thing its state words say: 'Sending now' is not stuck, 'Sent' has a time and a reference, 'Could not be sent' says why, 'Needs a rewrite' holds a reason, 'Held for approval' has no approval yet and a held queue row has a post behind it.
contract.sql:
/* display-result:social-states */
SELECT count(*)::int AS sample_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.bad = 1)::int AS bad_count
  FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN (p.status = 'posting' AND p.updated_at < now() - interval '30 minutes')
                OR (p.status = 'posted' AND (p.posted_at IS NULL OR NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p.external_post_id, '')), '') IS NULL))
                OR (p.status = 'failed' AND NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p.last_error, '')), '') IS NULL)
                OR (p.status = 'blocked' AND (p.blocked_reasons IS NULL OR p.blocked_reasons::text IN ('[]', 'null', '{}')))
                OR (p.status = 'awaiting_approval' AND p.approved_at IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bad
      FROM social_posts p
     WHERE p.org_id = $1::uuid AND p.created_at > now() - interval '180 days' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM partners pt WHERE pt.id = p.partner_id AND COALESCE(pt.is_demo, false) = true)
  UNION ALL
    SELECT CASE WHEN (q.status = 'awaiting_approval' AND q.social_post_id IS NULL)
                OR (q.status = 'blocked' AND (q.blocked_reasons IS NULL OR q.blocked_reasons::text IN ('[]', 'null', '{}'))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bad
      FROM marketing_content_queue q
     WHERE q.org_id = $1::uuid AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM partners pt WHERE pt.id = q.partner_id AND COALESCE(pt.is_demo, false) = true)
  ) r

contract.requirement: No post may be lined up, sending or sent without a passing copy check or a named person's approval, and every credit-repair post that is lined up or sent must carry a person's approval; every saved approval setting must sit in its partner's company.
contract.sql:
/* display-result:social-approval */
SELECT count(*)::int AS sample_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.bad = 1)::int AS bad_count
  FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN (p.offer_type = 'credit_repair' AND p.approved_at IS NULL)
                OR (p.approved_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM compliance_screenings s
             WHERE s.subject_type = 'social_post' AND s.subject_id = p.id AND s.state = 'passed'))
                OR (p.approved_at IS NOT NULL AND p.approved_by IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bad
      FROM social_posts p
     WHERE p.org_id = $1::uuid AND p.status IN ('queued', 'posting', 'posted')
      AND p.created_at > now() - interval '180 days' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM partners pt WHERE pt.id = p.partner_id AND COALESCE(pt.is_demo, false) = true)
  UNION ALL
    SELECT CASE WHEN (pt.org_id <> ms.org_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bad

contract.control: Capital Blueprint: Save ready date button
contract.requirement: Every client with a saved next-funding-sequence ready date must hold a REAL calendar day written YYYY-MM-DD (a 31 February is not one, and 29 February needs a leap year) and must be a paying Capital Blueprint buyer. The daily closer alert casts every saved day to a date in the database, and one day that is not on the calendar makes that read fail for the whole company. And the button promises "the closer gets a task on that day": once a saved day is two days past and the client record has not changed for 36 hours (the save time is not stored, so a record changed since then is not judged yet), the closer task the daily sweep makes for that day must exist. A dead sweep leaves a past ready date and no task.
contract.sql:
/* display-result:blueprint-ready-date */
SELECT count(*)::int AS sample_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.bad)::int AS bad_count
  FROM (
  SELECT ((NOT ((COALESCE((c.custom_fields->>'blueprint_next_sequence_ready_date')::text ~ '^(000[1-9]|00[1-9][0-9]|0[1-9][0-9][0-9]|[1-9][0-9][0-9][0-9])-((0[13578]|1[02])-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])|(0[469]|11)-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|30)|02-(0[1-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-8]))$', false)
         OR CASE WHEN (c.custom_fields->>'blueprint_next_sequence_ready_date')::text ~ '^[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-02-29$'
                 THEN (substr((c.custom_fields->>'blueprint_next_sequence_ready_date')::text, 1, 4)::int > 0 AND substr((c.custom_fields->>'blueprint_next_sequence_ready_date')::text, 1, 4)::int % 4 = 0 AND (substr((c.custom_fields->>'blueprint_next_sequence_ready_date')::text, 1, 4)::int % 100 <> 0 OR substr((c.custom_fields->>'blueprint_next_sequence_ready_date')::text, 1, 4)::int % 400 = 0)) ELSE false END)))
         OR (NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transactions tx JOIN products pr ON pr.id = resolve_product_id(tx.org_id, tx.product_name)
                  WHERE tx.org_id = c.org_id AND tx.client_id = c.id
                    AND lower(pr.code) = 'consulting-package'
                    AND lower(btrim(COALESCE(tx.status, ''))) = 'succeeded')))) AS bad
  FROM clients c
 WHERE c.org_id = $1::uuid
   AND (c.is_demo IS NOT TRUE) AND (NOT (NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(c.custom_fields->>'blueprint_next_sequence_ready_date'::text, '')), '') IS NULL))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tasks t WHERE (t.org_id = c.org_id) AND (t.client_id = c.id) AND (t.source_workflow = 'blueprint-next-funding-sequence') AND (t.body = ('blueprint-next-sequence:' || c.id::text || ':' || (c.custom_fields->>'blueprint_next_sequence_ready_date'))))) AS bad
  FROM clients c
 WHERE c.org_id = $1::uuid
   AND (c.is_demo IS NOT TRUE) AND (NOT (NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(c.custom_fields->>'blueprint_next_sequence_ready_date'::text, '')), '') IS NULL)) AND ((COALESCE((c.custom_fields->>'blueprint_next_sequence_ready_date')::text ~ '^(000[1-9]|00[1-9][0-9]|0[1-9][0-9][0-9]|[1-9][0-9][0-9][0-9])-((0[13578]|1[02])-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])|(0[469]|11)-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|30)|02-(0[1-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-8]))$', false)
         OR CASE WHEN (c.custom_fields->>'blueprint_next_sequence_ready_date')::text ~ '^[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-02-29$'
                 THEN (substr((c.custom_fields->>'blueprint_next_sequence_ready_date')::text, 1, 4)::int > 0 AND substr((c.custom_fields->>'blueprint_next_sequence_ready_date')::text, 1, 4)::int % 4 = 0 AND (substr((c.custom_fields->>'blueprint_next_sequence_ready_date')::text, 1, 4)::int % 100 <> 0 OR substr((c.custom_fields->>'blueprint_next_sequence_ready_date')::text, 1, 4)::int % 400 = 0)) ELSE false END)) AND (COALESCE((c.custom_fields->>'blueprint_next_sequence_ready_date')::text <= substr((now() - interval '2 days')::text, 1, 10), false)) AND (COALESCE(c.updated_at < now() - interval '2160 minutes', false)) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transactions tx JOIN products pr ON pr.id = resolve_product_id(tx.org_id, tx.product_name)

A chosen type the server does not know (it would be filed as other) is wrong; a file sent with no type chosen is filed as other and is not.
contract.sql:

SELECT count(*)::int AS sample_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE (v.id IS NULL)
         OR (NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(v.storage_key::text, '')), '') IS NULL)
         OR (d.storage_key IS DISTINCT FROM v.storage_key)
         OR (NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(v.checksum::text, '')), '') IS NULL)
         OR (d.checksum IS DISTINCT FROM v.checksum)
         OR (NOT (COALESCE(v.mime_type IN ('image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'application/pdf'), false)))
         OR (NOT (COALESCE(v.byte_size > 0, false)))
         OR (COALESCE(v.byte_size > 10485760, false))
         OR (k.id IS NULL)
         OR (d.metadata->'uploaded_by'->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'client')
         OR (a.id IS NULL)
         OR ((a.client_id IS DISTINCT FROM d.client_id) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM client_authorized_reps r WHERE (r.account_id = a.id) AND (r.client_id = d.client_id) AND (r.org_id = d.org_id))))
         OR (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE (e.org_id = d.org_id) AND (e.name = 'docs.received') AND (e.client_id = d.client_id) AND (e.payload->>'document_id' = d.id::text)))
         OR ((d.metadata->'label'->>'filed_as' IS NOT NULL) AND (d.subtype IS DISTINCT FROM d.metadata->'label'->>'filed_as'))
         OR ((COALESCE(d.created_at >= '2026-09-07T00:00:00.000Z'::timestamptz, false)) AND ((d.metadata->'label'->>'filed_as' IS NULL)
         OR ((d.metadata->'label'->>'given' IS NOT NULL) AND (d.metadata->'label'->>'given' IS DISTINCT FROM d.metadata->'label'->>'filed_as')))))::int AS bad_count
  FROM documents d
  LEFT JOIN document_versions v ON (v.id = d.current_version_id) AND (v.document_id = d.id)
  LEFT JOIN clients k ON (k.id = d.client_id) AND (k.org_id = d.org_id)
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON (a.id::text = d.metadata->'uploaded_by'->>'id') AND (a.org_id = d.org_id)
 WHERE d.org_id = $1::uuid
   AND (d.is_demo IS NOT TRUE) AND (d.kind = 'client_upload') AND (COALESCE(d.generated_by::text LIKE 'client:%', false))

contract.requirement: Every message sent from the chat widget by staff must be a delivered note on an internal thread the sender is on, or a client text or email that meets the staff reply rules; the Ask and Knowledge answers are held by the route's practice test.
contract.sql:
/* display-result:chat-widget */
SELECT count(DISTINCT m.id)::int AS sample_count,
       count(DISTINCT m.id) FILTER (WHERE
         (m.channel = 'internal' AND (s.id IS NULL
            OR m.client_id IS NOT NULL
            OR c.kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'internal' OR cp.staff_id IS NULL
            OR m.direction IS DISTINCT FROM 'outbound'
            OR m.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'delivered'
            OR NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(m.rendered_body, '')), '') IS NULL))
         OR (m.channel IN ('sms', 'email') AND (s.id IS NULL OR cl.id IS NULL
         OR c.kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'client'
         OR c.client_id IS DISTINCT FROM m.client_id
         OR c.channel IS DISTINCT FROM m.channel
         OR m.direction IS DISTINCT FROM 'outbound'
         OR NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(m.rendered_body, '')), '') IS NULL
         OR (m.status IN ('sent', 'delivered')
             AND (NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(m.provider, '')), '') IS NULL
                  OR NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(m.provider_message_id, '')), '') IS NULL))
         OR (m.status = 'failed'
             AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages later
                              WHERE later.org_id = m.org_id AND later.client_id = m.client_id
                                AND later.channel = m.channel AND later.direction = 'outbound'
                                AND later.status IN ('sent', 'delivered')
                                AND later.created_at > m.created_at))
         OR (m.status IN ('queued', 'sending') AND m.created_at < now() - interval '1 day')
         OR (m.status IN ('sent', 'delivered')
             AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opt_outs oo
                          WHERE oo.client_id = m.client_id AND oo.channel = m.channel
                            AND oo.opted_out_at < m.last_attempt_at
                            AND (oo.opted_in_at IS NULL OR oo.opted_in_at > m.last_attempt_at)))
         OR (m.channel = 'sms' AND m.status IN ('sent', 'delivered')
             AND (to_char(m.last_attempt_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Phoenix', 'HH24:MI') >= '20:01'
                  OR to_char(m.last_attempt_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Phoenix', 'HH24:MI') < '07:59')
             AND NOT (lower(split_part(COALESCE(cl.email, ''), '@', 1)) LIKE 'e2e+%'
             OR lower(split_part(COALESCE(cl.email, ''), '@', 1)) LIKE '%+sim-%'
             OR lower(split_part(COALESCE(cl.email, ''), '@', 1)) LIKE '%+colin-qa%'))
         OR (s.role IS DISTINCT FROM 'owner'
             AND COALESCE(m.provider_ref, '') NOT LIKE 'staff:pay-link-%'
             AND COALESCE(m.provider_ref, '') NOT LIKE 'staff:soft-pull-%'
             AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shifts sf
                              WHERE sf.org_id = m.org_id AND sf.staff_id = m.sender_staff_id
                                AND sf.started_at <= m.created_at
                                AND (sf.ended_at IS NULL OR sf.ended_at >= m.created_at)))
         OR (m.channel = 'sms' AND m.status IN ('sent', 'delivered')
             AND m.scheduled_at IS NULL AND m.attempts = 1
             AND s.role IS DISTINCT FROM 'owner'
             AND COALESCE(m.provider_ref, '') NOT LIKE 'staff:pay-link-%'
             AND COALESCE(m.provider_ref, '') NOT LIKE 'staff:soft-pull-%'
             AND (sh.staff_id IS DISTINCT FROM m.sender_staff_id
                  OR m.created_at < sh.started_at
                  OR m.created_at > sh.ended_at)))))::int AS bad_count
  FROM messages m
  LEFT JOIN staff s ON s.org_id = m.org_id AND s.id = m.sender_staff_id
  LEFT JOIN clients cl ON cl.org_id = m.org_id AND cl.id = m.client_id
  LEFT JOIN conversations c ON c.org_id = m.org_id AND c.id = m.conversation_id
  LEFT JOIN staff_events ev ON ev.org_id = m.org_id AND ev.kind = 'text_sent'
       AND ev.detail->>'message_id' = m.id::text
  LEFT JOIN shifts sh ON sh.org_id = ev.org_id AND sh.id = ev.shift_id
  LEFT JOIN conversation_participants cp ON cp.conversation_id = m.conversation_id
       AND cp.staff_id = m.sender_staff_id
 WHERE m.org_id = $1::uuid AND m.sender_kind = 'staff'
   AND m.channel IN ('internal', 'sms', 'email') AND m.is_demo = false
   AND COALESCE(m.provider_ref, '') NOT LIKE 'owner-ops:%'
   AND m.created_at > now() - interval '30 days'

contract.sql:
/* display-result:consent-wording-matches-server */
SELECT count(*)::int AS sample_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE (w.words IS NULL)
         OR (btrim(k.consent_text) IS DISTINCT FROM w.words))::int AS bad_count
  FROM client_consents k
  LEFT JOIN (VALUES
    ('dispute_authorization', 'dispute-auth-v1', 'I authorize Fundhub to prepare credit dispute letters and complaint drafts from my credit file for my review.

Letters and complaints are not mailed or filed until I send or file them, or until staff I authorize send or file them.

I must sign CFPB and state AG complaints myself before filing.

I may withdraw this authorization at any time.

Withdrawing this authorization does not undo letters already prepared.

This authorization makes no promise about deletions, scores, funding, or legal outcomes.'),
    ('call_recording', 'call-recording-v1', 'I agree that Fundhub may record this call, including my voice and what I say on it.

Fundhub uses the recording to keep an accurate record of the conversation and to improve how it serves clients.

This permission is only about recording. It does not allow Fundhub to use the recording, my voice, or my likeness in advertising or marketing. That is a separate permission I would be asked for on its own.

I may tell Fundhub to stop recording at any time, and I may withdraw this permission at any time, for any reason, without giving a reason.

I understand that withdrawing it does not erase a recording already made.'),
    ('marketing_use', 'marketing-use-v1', 'I allow Fundhub to use my name, my voice, my picture, and what I said in this conversation in its advertising and marketing.

This includes paid ads, its website, social media, and material shown to other people who are considering Fundhub.

I understand people who see it may recognise me.

I will not be paid for this unless Fundhub and I agree otherwise in writing.

Saying no changes nothing about the service I receive, and I may say no now or withdraw this permission later, at any time, for any reason, without giving a reason.

I understand that withdrawing it stops Fundhub using my words in anything new, but does not pull back material already published or already running.'),
    ('soft_pull_consent', 'soft-pull-v1', 'I authorize Fundhub to obtain my consumer credit report through a soft inquiry.

A soft inquiry does not affect my credit score and is not visible to lenders reviewing my file.

I understand this authorization stays in effect until it expires or until I withdraw it, and that I may withdraw it at any time, for any reason, without giving a reason.

I understand that withdrawing it does not undo a report already obtained, and does not affect anything already done with a report obtained while this authorization was in effect.'),
    ('soft_pull_consent', 'soft-pull-v2', 'I authorize Fundhub to obtain my consumer credit report through a soft inquiry.

A soft inquiry does not affect my credit score and is not visible to lenders reviewing my file.

I understand this authorization stays in effect until it expires or until I withdraw it, and that I may withdraw it at any time, for any reason, without giving a reason.

I understand that withdrawing it does not undo a report already obtained, and does not affect anything already done with a report obtained while this authorization was in effect.

I agree that Fundhub may call me and send me text messages at the phone number I gave, including messages sent by an automatic dialing system, about my file and the services I asked for.

Message and data rates may apply, and how often I am messaged varies. I can reply STOP at any time to stop the texts, or HELP for help.

I understand that agreeing to calls and texts is not a condition of buying anything from Fundhub, and that I may withdraw it at any time without affecting my order or my soft pull authorization.'),
    ('soft_pull_consent', 'soft-pull-v3', 'I authorize Fundhub LLC to run a soft pull of my credit report. A soft pull does not affect my credit score. I also agree Fundhub LLC may call and text me at the number I gave, including automated texts, about my file. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to stop. Agreeing to texts is not a condition of buying anything.')
  ) w(kind, version, words) ON (w.kind = k.kind) AND (w.version = k.consent_version)
  LEFT JOIN clients cl ON (cl.id = k.client_id) AND (cl.org_id = k.org_id)
 WHERE k.org_id = $1::uuid
   AND (cl.is_demo IS NOT TRUE) AND ((COALESCE(k.kind IN ('dispute_authorization', 'call_recording', 'marketing_use'), false))

contract.requirement: Every wording that was edited must name a staff editor in the same company who is an owner or an admin (an edit that stopped recording who made it is wrong, whether the wording is text or an uploaded PDF, and so is a closer or any other role changing legal wording, which the handler refuses). And every contract already sent, viewed, signed or voided must still hold the words whose fingerprint was stored in its frozen copy (document_versions.checksum, the one the contract row cannot rewrite), and the contract row's own fingerprint must agree with it, so rewriting the words and the row's fingerprint together is seen. Wordings that only a migration rewrote are left out, and a blank name or blank words are refused by database rules, so they are not judged here.
contract.sql:
/* display-result:contract-wording-edited */
SELECT count(*)::int AS sample_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.bad)::int AS bad_count
  FROM (
  SELECT ((s.id IS NULL)
         OR (NOT COALESCE(lower(btrim(s.role)) IN ('owner', 'admin'), false))) AS bad
  FROM contract_templates t
  LEFT JOIN staff s ON (s.id = t.updated_by) AND (s.org_id = t.org_id)
 WHERE t.org_id = $1::uuid
   AND (t.is_demo IS NOT TRUE) AND ((t.updated_by IS NOT NULL)
         OR ((COALESCE(t.created_at < t.updated_at, false)) AND ((NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM schema_migrations m WHERE m.applied_at >= t.updated_at - interval '5 minutes' AND m.applied_at <= t.updated_at + interval '5 minutes')))))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ((k.document_version_id IS NULL)
         OR (v.id IS NULL)
         OR (v.checksum IS NULL)
         OR (('sha256:' || encode(sha256(convert_to(COALESCE(k.rendered_body, ''), 'UTF8')), 'hex')) IS DISTINCT FROM v.checksum)
         OR (k.body_sha IS NULL)
         OR (k.body_sha IS DISTINCT FROM ('sha256:' || encode(sha256(convert_to(COALESCE(k.rendered_body, ''), 'UTF8')), 'hex')))) AS bad
  FROM contracts k
  LEFT JOIN document_versions v ON (v.id = k.document_version_id) AND (v.org_id = k.org_id)
 WHERE k.org_id = $1::uuid
   AND (k.is_demo IS NOT TRUE) AND (COALESCE(k.status IN ('sent', 'viewed', 'signed', 'void'), false)) AND (k.rendered_body IS NOT NULL)
  ) x

contract.requirement: Every message sent from the chat widget by staff must be a delivered note on an internal thread the sender is on, or a client text or email that meets the staff reply rules; the Ask and Knowledge answers are held by the route's practice test.
contract.sql:
/* display-result:chat-widget */
SELECT count(DISTINCT m.id)::int AS sample_count,
       count(DISTINCT m.id) FILTER (WHERE
         (m.channel = 'internal' AND (s.id IS NULL
            OR m.client_id IS NOT NULL
            OR c.kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'internal' OR cp.staff_id IS NULL
            OR m.direction IS DISTINCT FROM 'outbound'
            OR m.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'delivered'
            OR NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(m.rendered_body, '')), '') IS NULL))
         OR (m.channel IN ('sms', 'email') AND (s.id IS NULL OR cl.id IS NULL
         OR c.kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'client'
         OR c.client_id IS DISTINCT FROM m.client_id
         OR c.channel IS DISTINCT FROM m.channel
         OR m.direction IS DISTINCT FROM 'outbound'
         OR NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(m.rendered_body, '')), '') IS NULL
         OR (m.status IN ('sent', 'delivered')
             AND (NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(m.provider, '')), '') IS NULL
                  OR NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(m.provider_message_id, '')), '') IS NULL))
         OR (m.status = 'failed'
             AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages later
                              WHERE later.org_id = m.org_id AND later.client_id = m.client_id
                                AND later.channel = m.channel AND later.direction = 'outbound'
                                AND later.status IN ('sent', 'delivered')
                                AND later.created_at > m.created_at))
         OR (m.status IN ('queued', 'sending') AND m.created_at < now() - interval '1 day')
         OR (m.status IN ('sent', 'delivered')
             AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opt_outs oo
                          WHERE oo.client_id = m.client_id AND oo.channel = m.channel
                            AND oo.opted_out_at < m.last_attempt_at
                            AND (oo.opted_in_at IS NULL OR oo.opted_in_at > m.last_attempt_at)))
         OR (m.channel = 'sms' AND m.status IN ('sent', 'delivered')
             AND (to_char(m.last_attempt_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Phoenix', 'HH24:MI') >= '20:01'
                  OR to_char(m.last_attempt_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Phoenix', 'HH24:MI') < '07:59')
             AND NOT (lower(split_part(COALESCE(cl.email, ''), '@', 1)) LIKE 'e2e+%'
             OR lower(split_part(COALESCE(cl.email, ''), '@', 1)) LIKE '%+sim-%'
             OR lower(split_part(COALESCE(cl.email, ''), '@', 1)) LIKE '%+colin-qa%'))
         OR (s.role IS DISTINCT FROM 'owner'
             AND COALESCE(m.provider_ref, '') NOT LIKE 'staff:pay-link-%'
             AND COALESCE(m.provider_ref, '') NOT LIKE 'staff:soft-pull-%'
             AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shifts sf
                              WHERE sf.org_id = m.org_id AND sf.staff_id = m.sender_staff_id
                                AND sf.started_at <= m.created_at
                                AND (sf.ended_at IS NULL OR sf.ended_at >= m.created_at)))
         OR (m.channel = 'sms' AND m.status IN ('sent', 'delivered')
             AND m.scheduled_at IS NULL AND m.attempts = 1
             AND s.role IS DISTINCT FROM 'owner'
             AND COALESCE(m.provider_ref, '') NOT LIKE 'staff:pay-link-%'
             AND COALESCE(m.provider_ref, '') NOT LIKE 'staff:soft-pull-%'
             AND (sh.staff_id IS DISTINCT FROM m.sender_staff_id
                  OR m.created_at < sh.started_at
                  OR m.created_at > sh.ended_at)))))::int AS bad_count
  FROM messages m
  LEFT JOIN staff s ON s.org_id = m.org_id AND s.id = m.sender_staff_id
  LEFT JOIN clients cl ON cl.org_id = m.org_id AND cl.id = m.client_id
  LEFT JOIN conversations c ON c.org_id = m.org_id AND c.id = m.conversation_id
  LEFT JOIN staff_events ev ON ev.org_id = m.org_id AND ev.kind = 'text_sent'
       AND ev.detail->>'message_id' = m.id::text
  LEFT JOIN shifts sh ON sh.org_id = ev.org_id AND sh.id = ev.shift_id
  LEFT JOIN conversation_participants cp ON cp.conversation_id = m.conversation_id
       AND cp.staff_id = m.sender_staff_id
 WHERE m.org_id = $1::uuid AND m.sender_kind = 'staff'
   AND m.channel IN ('internal', 'sms', 'email') AND m.is_demo = false
   AND COALESCE(m.provider_ref, '') NOT LIKE 'owner-ops:%'
   AND m.created_at > now() - interval '30 days'

contract.requirement: Every active hiring role the tiles add up must show the open applications and the bench people a recount of its own applications gives, with its short-by number its target minus that bench and never below zero; every open application must sit in a stage where a person is still being considered and belong to an active role, so the open number cannot count someone who is no longer open or leave someone out. WAITING ON YOU is read from the candidates list and is judged by the page test, not here.
contract.sql:
/* display-result:hiring-bench-tiles */
SELECT count(*)::int AS sample_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.bad = 1)::int AS bad_count
  FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN (b.open_applications <> (SELECT count(*) FROM candidate_applications a WHERE a.role_id = b.role_id AND a.status = 'open'))
                OR (b.bench_count <> (SELECT count(*) FROM candidate_applications a JOIN pipeline_stages s ON s.id = a.stage_id
                 WHERE a.role_id = b.role_id AND a.status = 'open' AND s.key IN ('one_on_one', 'offer')))
                OR (b.bench_shortfall <> CASE WHEN b.bench_target - (SELECT count(*) FROM candidate_applications a JOIN pipeline_stages s ON s.id = a.stage_id
                 WHERE a.role_id = b.role_id AND a.status = 'open' AND s.key IN ('one_on_one', 'offer')) > 0 THEN b.bench_target - (SELECT count(*) FROM candidate_applications a JOIN pipeline_stages s ON s.id = a.stage_id
                 WHERE a.role_id = b.role_id AND a.status = 'open' AND s.key IN ('one_on_one', 'offer')) ELSE 0 END) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bad
      FROM v_hiring_bench b
     WHERE b.org_id = $1::uuid
  UNION ALL
    SELECT CASE WHEN (s.key NOT IN ('applied', 'screening', 'group_interview', 'one_on_one', 'offer'))
                OR (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_roles r WHERE r.id = a.role_id AND r.active = true)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bad
      FROM candidate_applications a
      JOIN pipeline_stages s ON s.id = a.stage_id
      JOIN candidates c ON c.id = a.candidate_id
     WHERE a.org_id = $1::uuid AND a.status = 'open'
      AND COALESCE(c.is_demo, false) = false
      AND COALESCE(c.source_detail, '') <> 'platform_demo'
      AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(c.full_name, ''), 1, 5) NOT IN ('DEMO ', 'DEMO-', 'DEMO—')
  ) r

contract.requirement: Every open application a card opens must have its candidate and role in this company, a video tag that is a web address, and a resume tag that points at a document of this company; every score on file must keep its flags as a list and belong to an application of this company.       FROM candidate_applications a
     WHERE a.org_id = $1::uuid AND a.status = 'open'
  UNION ALL

      FROM application_scores sc
     WHERE sc.org_id = $1::uuid

      FROM lender_bureau_observations o
     WHERE o.org_id = $1::uuid AND o.review_status = 'pending' AND o.mismatch_flag = true
  UNION ALL
    SELECT CASE WHEN (e.one = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bad
      FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) e
     WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lenders x WHERE x.org_id = $1::uuid AND COALESCE(x.is_demo, false) = false)

                          WHERE oo.client_id = m.client_id AND oo.channel = m.channel

             AND COALESCE(m.provider_ref, '') NOT LIKE 'staff:pay-link-%'

             AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shifts sf
                              WHERE sf.org_id = m.org_id AND sf.staff_id = m.sender_staff_id

         OR (m.channel = 'sms' AND m.status IN ('sent', 'delivered')
             AND m.scheduled_at IS NULL AND m.attempts = 1

SELECT count(DISTINCT m.id)::int AS sample_count,
       count(DISTINCT m.id) FILTER (WHERE

         OR (m.status = 'blocked'
             AND (NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(m.blocked_reason, '')), '') IS NULL
                  AND NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(m.last_error, '')), '') IS NULL))

             AND (t.assignee_role IS NULL OR t.assignee_role NOT IN ('owner', 'admin', 'funding_advisor', 'closer', 'inquiry_specialist', 'setter', 'sales_manager', 'csm')))
         OR (m.status IN ('sent', 'delivered')
             AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opt_outs oo
                          WHERE oo.client_id = m.client_id AND oo.channel = m.channel
                            AND oo.opted_out_at < m.last_attempt_at
                            AND (oo.opted_in_at IS NULL OR oo.opted_in_at > m.last_attempt_at)))
         OR (m.status IN ('sent', 'delivered')
             AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM compliance_rules cr
                          WHERE cr.org_id = m.org_id AND cr.active = true

contract.control: Header: Apply to code and bottom-bar Apply (saves every edited journey)
contract.requirement: Every saved journey must have its steps as a list, a name, a start line and an end line, a key the editor owns, and every step (also the steps inside a question's paths) must be what api/journeys.mjs lets in on save: a known kind with its settings stored as a list of settings; a wait with a length above zero and minutes, hours or days; a question with something to check and two properly stored paths; a move with a pipeline and a stage; and no text or email body or subject with a single brace.
contract.sql:
/* display-result:journeys-apply-saved */
WITH RECURSIVE steps(journey_id, step) AS (
  SELECT j.id, e.value
    FROM journeys j,
         jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(j.nodes) = 'array' THEN j.nodes ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) AS e(value)
   WHERE j.org_id = $1::uuid AND COALESCE(j.is_demo, false) = false
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.journey_id, c.value
    FROM steps s,
         jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.step -> 'branches') = 'array' THEN s.step -> 'branches' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) AS b(value),
         jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(b.value -> 'nodes') = 'array' THEN b.value -> 'nodes' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) AS c(value)
),
bad_steps AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT journey_id
    FROM steps
   WHERE (jsonb_typeof(step) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object')
         OR (jsonb_typeof(step) = 'object' AND CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(step -> 'type') = 'string' THEN COALESCE(step ->> 'type', '') ~ '^\s*$' ELSE true END)
         OR (jsonb_typeof(step -> 'type') = 'string' AND NOT (COALESCE(step ->> 'type', '') ~ '^\s*$') AND step ->> 'type' NOT IN ('sms', 'email', 'wait', 'condition', 'stage', 'assign', 'handoff', 'agent', 'payment', 'record'))
         OR (step -> 'cfg' IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(step -> 'cfg') NOT IN ('object', 'null'))
         OR (step ->> 'type' = 'wait' AND COALESCE(step -> 'cfg' ->> 'unit', '') NOT IN ('minutes', 'hours', 'days'))
         OR (step ->> 'type' = 'wait' AND NOT COALESCE((CASE jsonb_typeof(step -> 'cfg' -> 'amount')
              WHEN 'number' THEN CAST(step -> 'cfg' ->> 'amount' AS numeric) > 0
              WHEN 'boolean' THEN step -> 'cfg' -> 'amount' = 'true'
              WHEN 'string' THEN CASE
                WHEN regexp_replace(step -> 'cfg' ->> 'amount', '^\s+|\s+$', '', 'g') ~ '^[+]?([0-9]+[.]?[0-9]*|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
                  THEN CAST(regexp_replace(step -> 'cfg' ->> 'amount', '^\s+|\s+$', '', 'g') AS numeric) > 0 AND CAST(regexp_replace(step -> 'cfg' ->> 'amount', '^\s+|\s+$', '', 'g') AS numeric) < 1.7976931348623157e308
                WHEN regexp_replace(step -> 'cfg' ->> 'amount', '^\s+|\s+$', '', 'g') ~ '^0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]*[1-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F]*$|^0[bB][01]*1[01]*$|^0[oO][0-7]*[1-7][0-7]*$' THEN true
                ELSE false END
              ELSE false END), false))
         OR (step ->> 'type' = 'condition' AND CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(step -> 'cfg' -> 'field') = 'string' THEN COALESCE(step -> 'cfg' ->> 'field', '') ~ '^\s*$' ELSE true END)
         OR (step ->> 'type' = 'condition' AND CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(step -> 'branches') = 'array'
              THEN jsonb_array_length(step -> 'branches') = 0 ELSE true END)
         OR (step ->> 'type' = 'condition' AND jsonb_typeof(step -> 'branches') = 'array' AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(step -> 'branches') = 'array' THEN step -> 'branches' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) AS pb(value)
               WHERE jsonb_typeof(pb.value -> 'nodes') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'))
         OR (step ->> 'type' = 'stage' AND (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(step -> 'cfg' -> 'stage') = 'string' THEN COALESCE(step -> 'cfg' ->> 'stage', '') ~ '^\s*$' ELSE true END OR CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(step -> 'cfg' -> 'pipeline') = 'string' THEN COALESCE(step -> 'cfg' ->> 'pipeline', '') ~ '^\s*$' ELSE true END))
         OR (step ->> 'type' IN ('sms', 'email') AND regexp_replace(COALESCE(step -> 'cfg' ->> 'body', ''), '[{][{]\s*[A-Za-z0-9_]+([.][A-Za-z0-9_]+)*\s*[}][}]', '', 'g') ~ '[{][A-Za-z0-9_]+[}]')
         OR (step ->> 'type' IN ('sms', 'email') AND regexp_replace(COALESCE(step -> 'cfg' ->> 'subject', ''), '[{][{]\s*[A-Za-z0-9_]+([.][A-Za-z0-9_]+)*\s*[}][}]', '', 'g') ~ '[{][A-Za-z0-9_]+[}]')
)
SELECT count(*)::int AS sample_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE (jsonb_typeof(j.nodes) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array')
         OR (COALESCE(j.name, '') ~ '^\s*$')
         OR (COALESCE(j.start_when, '') ~ '^\s*$')
         OR (COALESCE(j.end_when, '') ~ '^\s*$')
         OR (j.key NOT IN ('client', 'setter', 'closer', 'advisor', 'affiliate', 'partner'))
         OR j.id IN (SELECT journey_id FROM bad_steps))::int AS bad_count
  FROM journeys j
 WHERE j.org_id = $1::uuid AND COALESCE(j.is_demo, false) = false

SELECT count(*)::int AS sample_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE (NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(j.payload ->> 'run_cap_usd', '')), '') IS NULL
         OR (j.payload ->> 'run_cap_usd')::numeric <= 0)

                          WHERE u.org_id = j.org_id AND u.job_id = j.id), 0)
         + COALESCE((SELECT (COALESCE(sum(u.input_tokens), 0) * 4

                           + COALESCE(sum(u.cache_read_tokens), 0) * 0.2
                           + COALESCE(sum(u.cache_write_tokens), 0) * 5) / 1000000.0
                           + COALESCE(sum(u.web_search_requests), 0) * 0.01
                      FROM marketing_model_usage u
                     WHERE u.org_id = j.org_id AND u.job_id = j.id AND u.cost_usd IS NULL), 0)) > (j.payload ->> 'run_cap_usd')::numeric)
         OR (j.status = 'done' AND (j.payload ->> 'step') IS DISTINCT FROM 'done')

contract.requirement: Every model call saved this month must carry its price when the price is on file: each of the three priced models (claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-code) must be saved with a cost, that cost must equal its tokens at the model's price plus a cent for each web search (claude-code costs nothing), because the meter adds these costs up and counts an unknown cost at the worst-case rate.
contract.sql:
/* display-result:mkt-month-meter */
SELECT count(*)::int AS sample_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.bad = 1)::int AS bad_count
  FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN (u.model IN ('claude-opus-5-5', 'claude-sonnet-5-5', 'claude-code') AND u.cost_usd IS NULL)
                OR ((u.model = 'claude-opus-5-5' AND u.cost_usd IS NOT NULL AND ABS(u.cost_usd - ((u.input_tokens * 4 + u.output_tokens * 20 + u.cache_read_tokens * 0.2 + u.cache_write_tokens * 5) / 1000000.0 + u.web_search_requests * 0.01)) > 0.00001)
                OR (u.model = 'claude-sonnet-5-5' AND u.cost_usd IS NOT NULL AND ABS(u.cost_usd - ((u.input_tokens * 2 + u.output_tokens * 10 + u.cache_read_tokens * 0.2 + u.cache_write_tokens * 2.5) / 1000000.0 + u.web_search_requests * 0.01)) > 0.00001)
                OR (u.model = 'claude-code' AND u.cost_usd IS NOT NULL AND u.cost_usd <> 0)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bad
      FROM marketing_model_usage u
     WHERE u.org_id = $1::uuid AND u.created_at >= now() - interval '35 days'
  ) r

contract.control: Settings: schedule fields: drop day, drop time (Arizona), scripts a day, days in a batch, count rule (total / per funnel), style for each of 6 script kinds, drafts expiry
contract.requirement: Every weekly batch planned under the saved schedule must drop on the saved weekday and time, hold the saved count, and be released within two hours of its drop time; a switched-on schedule must have made a weekly batch within nine days of the last save; every machine script written since the last save must carry the style saved for its kind; and no machine draft may be a draft past the saved expiry days or expired before them.
contract.sql:
/* display-result:fin-b16-schedule-fields */
SELECT count(*)::int AS sample_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.bad = 1)::int AS bad_count
  FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(dow FROM (b.release_at AT TIME ZONE s.timezone)) <> s.batch_weekday)
              OR ((b.release_at AT TIME ZONE s.timezone)::time <> s.batch_time)
              OR (b.plan IS NOT NULL AND (b.plan ->> 'size_rule') IS DISTINCT FROM s.size_rule)
              OR (b.plan IS NOT NULL AND (b.plan ->> 'size_rule') = 'total'
         AND COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(b.plan -> 'overrides'), 'null') = 'null'
         AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM marketing_funnels f WHERE f.org_id = b.org_id AND f.active = true)
         AND (b.plan ->> 'total')::int <> s.scripts_per_day * s.days_per_batch)
              OR (b.plan IS NOT NULL AND (b.plan ->> 'size_rule') = 'per_funnel'
         AND COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(b.plan -> 'overrides'), 'null') = 'null'
         AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM marketing_funnels f WHERE f.org_id = b.org_id AND f.active = true)
         AND (b.plan ->> 'total')::int % (s.scripts_per_day * s.days_per_batch) <> 0)
              OR (b.status = 'released' AND b.released_at > b.release_at + interval '2 hours')
              OR (b.status IN ('planned', 'writing', 'ready') AND b.release_at < now() - interval '2 hours') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bad
      FROM marketing_batches b
      JOIN marketing_settings s ON s.org_id = b.org_id
     WHERE b.org_id = $1::uuid
       AND b.kind = 'weekly'
       AND b.status <> 'failed'
       AND b.release_at IS NOT NULL
       AND b.release_at > s.updated_at + interval '3 hours'
  UNION ALL
    SELECT CASE WHEN (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM marketing_batches w
                 WHERE w.org_id = s.org_id AND w.kind = 'weekly' AND w.release_at > s.updated_at)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bad
      FROM marketing_settings s
     WHERE s.org_id = $1::uuid
       AND s.enabled = true
       AND s.updated_at < now() - interval '9 days'
  UNION ALL
    SELECT CASE WHEN ((s.format_style ->> a.script_format) IS NOT NULL AND a.style IS DISTINCT FROM (s.format_style ->> a.script_format)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bad
      FROM ad_scripts a
      JOIN marketing_settings s ON s.org_id = a.org_id
     WHERE a.org_id = $1::uuid
       AND a.source = 'machine'
       AND a.script_format IS NOT NULL
       AND a.created_at >= s.updated_at
  UNION ALL
    SELECT CASE WHEN (a.status = 'draft' AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - b.released_at)) > (s.draft_expiry_days + 2) * 86400)
              OR (a.status = 'expired' AND b.released_at >= s.updated_at
         AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - b.released_at)) < s.draft_expiry_days * 86400) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bad
      FROM ad_scripts a
      JOIN marketing_batches b ON b.id = a.batch_id AND b.org_id = a.org_id
      JOIN marketing_settings s ON s.org_id = a.org_id
     WHERE a.org_id = $1::uuid
       AND a.source = 'machine'
       AND a.archived_at IS NULL
       AND a.status IN ('draft', 'expired')
       AND b.status = 'released'
       AND b.released_at IS NOT NULL
  ) r

      JOIN inquiry_removal_cases k ON k.id = COALESCE(l.inquiry_removal_case_id, l.case_id)
     WHERE t.org_id = $1::uuid AND COALESCE(k.is_demo, false) = false AND t.kind = 'portal'
      AND LOWER(COALESCE(t.outcome, '')) = 'uploaded' AND LOWER(COALESCE(t.note, '')) LIKE 'experian_ref:%'
  UNION ALL
    SELECT CASE WHEN (NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(k.letter_provider_id, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bad
      FROM inquiry_attempts t
      JOIN inquiry_log l ON l.id = t.inquiry_id
      JOIN inquiry_removal_cases k ON k.id = COALESCE(l.inquiry_removal_case_id, l.case_id)
     WHERE t.org_id = $1::uuid AND COALESCE(k.is_demo, false) = false AND t.kind = 'letter'
      AND LOWER(COALESCE(t.outcome, '')) = 'sent'
  UNION ALL
    SELECT CASE WHEN (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inquiry_attempts u WHERE u.inquiry_id = t.inquiry_id AND u.kind = 'letter'
                AND u.created_at > t.created_at AND LOWER(COALESCE(u.outcome, '')) NOT LIKE 'mail_failed%')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bad
      FROM inquiry_attempts t
      JOIN inquiry_log l ON l.id = t.inquiry_id
     WHERE t.org_id = $1::uuid AND COALESCE(l.is_demo, false) = false AND t.kind = 'letter'
      AND LOWER(COALESCE(t.outcome, '')) LIKE 'mail_failed%'
  ) r

contract.control: Case drawer: 'Send' button (letter to the bureau by PostGrid mail and/or Experian portal; refused while the identity packet is short)
contract.requirement: A case that holds a mail provider id or an Experian portal reference must have the matching sent letter or portal attempt for ITS OWN bureau after it was requested, a real client, and never read Queued; and a case that reads In Progress after a mail that failed must have a sent letter too.
contract.sql:
/* display-result:fin-b07-case-send */
SELECT count(*)::int AS sample_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE cl.id IS NULL
         OR c.case_status::text = 'Queued'
         OR (c.letter_provider_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM inquiry_attempts a
                 JOIN inquiry_log l ON l.id = a.inquiry_id
                WHERE a.org_id = c.org_id AND l.client_id = c.client_id
                  AND upper(COALESCE(l.bureau, '')) = upper(COALESCE(c.selected_bureaus_raw, ''))
                  AND a.created_at >= c.requested_at
                  AND a.kind = 'letter' AND a.outcome = 'sent'))
         OR (c.portal_confirmation IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM inquiry_attempts a
                 JOIN inquiry_log l ON l.id = a.inquiry_id
                WHERE a.org_id = c.org_id AND l.client_id = c.client_id
                  AND upper(COALESCE(l.bureau, '')) = upper(COALESCE(c.selected_bureaus_raw, ''))
                  AND a.created_at >= c.requested_at
                  AND a.kind = 'portal' AND a.note = 'experian_ref:' || c.portal_confirmation))
         OR (c.case_status::text = 'In Progress'
             AND c.letter_provider_id IS NULL AND c.portal_confirmation IS NULL
             AND EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM inquiry_attempts a
                 JOIN inquiry_log l ON l.id = a.inquiry_id
                WHERE a.org_id = c.org_id AND l.client_id = c.client_id
                  AND upper(COALESCE(l.bureau, '')) = upper(COALESCE(c.selected_bureaus_raw, ''))
                  AND a.created_at >= c.requested_at
                  AND a.kind = 'letter' AND a.outcome LIKE 'mail_failed%')
             AND NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM inquiry_attempts a
                 JOIN inquiry_log l ON l.id = a.inquiry_id
                WHERE a.org_id = c.org_id AND l.client_id = c.client_id
                  AND upper(COALESCE(l.bureau, '')) = upper(COALESCE(c.selected_bureaus_raw, ''))
                  AND a.created_at >= c.requested_at
                  AND a.kind = 'letter' AND a.outcome = 'sent')))::int AS bad_count
  FROM inquiry_removal_cases c
  LEFT JOIN clients cl ON cl.org_id = c.org_id AND cl.id = c.client_id
 WHERE c.org_id = $1::uuid
   AND (c.letter_provider_id IS NOT NULL OR c.portal_confirmation IS NOT NULL
        OR EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM inquiry_attempts a
               JOIN inquiry_log l ON l.id = a.inquiry_id
              WHERE a.org_id = c.org_id AND l.client_id = c.client_id
                  AND upper(COALESCE(l.bureau, '')) = upper(COALESCE(c.selected_bureaus_raw, ''))
                  AND a.created_at >= c.requested_at
                AND a.kind IN ('letter', 'portal')))
   AND COALESCE(c.is_demo, false) = false
   AND c.updated_at >= now() - interval '60 days'

contract.control: Case drawer: 'Call bureau' button (AI voice call to the bureau, uses DOB/SSN; disabled once fired)
contract.requirement: Every bureau call placed in the last 30 days must have, for that client, a number-reveal log entry and a case stamped as fired, each within five minutes of the call itself. A second launch on a case that was already stamped (the button is disabled by the page only, the server does not refuse it) has no new stamp and is seen, and so is a call whose case was never stamped; a case the scheduler stamped without placing a call does not answer for a call. What this cannot see: a repeat placed within five minutes of a launch on another case of the same client, and a call placed whose dispatch record failed to write.
contract.sql:
/* display-result:inquiry-bureau-call */
SELECT count(*)::int AS sample_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pii_access_log p WHERE (p.org_id = o.org_id) AND (p.client_id = o.client_id) AND (p.field = 'ssn (bureau_dispute_call)') AND (COALESCE(p.created_at >= o.created_at - interval '5 minutes' AND p.created_at <= o.created_at + interval '5 minutes', false))))
         OR (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inquiry_removal_cases r WHERE (r.org_id = o.org_id) AND (r.client_id = o.client_id) AND (COALESCE(r.call_fired_at >= o.created_at - interval '5 minutes' AND r.call_fired_at <= o.created_at + interval '5 minutes', false)))))::int AS bad_count
  FROM outbound_calls o
 WHERE o.org_id = $1::uuid
   AND (o.kind = 'inquiry_bureau') AND (COALESCE(o.created_at > now() - interval '30 days', false))

                OR NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(s.name, '')), '') IS NULL))
      + (SELECT count(*) FROM pii_identity p
          JOIN clients c ON c.org_id = p.org_id AND c.id = p.client_id
         WHERE p.org_id = $1::uuid AND p.ssn_enc IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(c.is_demo, false) = false

      + (SELECT count(*) FROM repair_programs rp

contract.control: 'Needs a human read' list: low-confidence bureau answers and stuck clients; 'Mark as checked' button
contract.requirement: Every bureau answer that needed a person (no confidence at all, low confidence, or held for escalation) and is marked checked must carry the confirm time and a staff member in the same company who confirmed it; every answer a person confirmed must have the confirm record the button writes (a parse.confirmed entry for that client and case, written within five minutes of the confirm, naming that same person), so a flag flipped with nothing advanced is seen; no bureau answer on a real client may sit unchecked past the repair program's own 24 hour clock, which is how a list that hides an answer shows up; and no real client's repair card may sit on the Stalled stage past that same 24 hour human-read clock (the program sets no clock for Stalled, so this is the one it has), because the list exists so a person moves it.
contract.sql:
/* display-result:repair-parse-confirmed */
SELECT count(*)::int AS sample_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.bad)::int AS bad_count
  FROM (
  SELECT ((r.confirmed_at IS NULL)
         OR (r.confirmed_by IS NULL)
         OR (s.id IS NULL)) AS bad
  FROM dispute_responses r
  LEFT JOIN staff s ON (s.id = r.confirmed_by) AND (s.org_id = r.org_id)
 WHERE r.org_id = $1::uuid
   AND (r.confirmed = true) AND ((r.confidence IS NULL)
         OR (COALESCE(r.confidence < 0.85, false))
         OR (r.parse_json->>'heldForEscalation' = 'true'))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT (COALESCE(r.created_at < now() - interval '1440 minutes', false)) AS bad
  FROM dispute_responses r
  LEFT JOIN clients k ON (k.id = r.client_id) AND (k.org_id = r.org_id)
 WHERE r.org_id = $1::uuid
   AND (r.confirmed IS DISTINCT FROM true) AND (k.is_demo IS NOT TRUE)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM repair_decision_log l WHERE (l.org_id = r.org_id) AND (l.client_id = r.client_id) AND (l.case_id = r.case_id) AND (l.decision = 'parse.confirmed') AND (lower(btrim(l.payload->>'confirmedBy')) = lower(btrim(r.confirmed_by::text))) AND (COALESCE(l.created_at >= r.confirmed_at - interval '5 minutes' AND l.created_at <= r.confirmed_at + interval '5 minutes', false)))) AS bad
  FROM dispute_responses r
 WHERE r.org_id = $1::uuid
   AND (r.confirmed = true) AND (r.confirmed_by IS NOT NULL)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT (COALESCE(ca.updated_at < now() - interval '1440 minutes', false)) AS bad
  FROM cards ca
  LEFT JOIN pipeline_stages ps ON ps.id = ca.stage_id
  LEFT JOIN pipelines p ON (p.id = ca.pipeline_id) AND (p.key = 'optimization')
  LEFT JOIN clients k ON (k.id = ca.client_id) AND (k.org_id = ca.org_id)
 WHERE ca.org_id = $1::uuid
   AND (ca.is_demo IS NOT TRUE) AND (k.is_demo IS NOT TRUE) AND (p.id IS NOT NULL) AND (ps.key = 'stalled')
  ) x

                              AND COALESCE(mt.status, '') <> 'failed'

                              AND o.channel = 'sms' AND o.opted_in_at IS NULL)))))::int AS bad_count
  FROM events e

contract.sql:
/* display-result:round-submitted */
SELECT count(DISTINCT cd.id)::int AS sample_count,
       count(DISTINCT cd.id) FILTER (WHERE (e.id IS NULL AND cd.entered_at < now() - interval '1 hour')
         OR (e.id IS NOT NULL AND (e.payload->>'stage' IS DISTINCT FROM 'round_submitted'
              OR e.payload->>'source' IS DISTINCT FROM 'card_stacking'
              OR e.payload->>'rail' IS DISTINCT FROM 'card_stacking'
              OR e.payload->>'product' IS DISTINCT FROM 'card_stacking'
              OR COALESCE(e.payload->>'roundNumber', '') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
              OR e.idempotency_key IS DISTINCT FROM 'card_stacking:' || e.client_id::text || ':'
                   || COALESCE(e.payload->>'roundNumber', '') || ':round_submitted:round.submitted'
              OR (e.created_at < now() - interval '1 hour' AND (fr.id IS NULL
                   OR ((NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages mt WHERE mt.org_id = e.org_id
                       AND mt.provider_ref = 'workflow:SMS-F03-ROUND-SUBMITTED:' || e.id::text
                       AND COALESCE(mt.status, '') <> 'failed'
                       AND NOT (mt.status IN ('queued', 'sending') AND mt.created_at < now() - interval '1 day'))
                AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opt_outs o WHERE o.client_id = e.client_id
                       AND o.channel = 'sms' AND o.opted_in_at IS NULL))
              OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages me WHERE me.org_id = e.org_id
                       AND me.provider_ref = 'workflow:EMAIL-F03-ROUND-SUBMITTED:' || e.id::text
                       AND COALESCE(me.status, '') <> 'failed'
                       AND NOT (me.status IN ('queued', 'sending') AND me.created_at < now() - interval '1 day'))))))))::int AS bad_count

  LEFT JOIN pipeline_stages ps ON ps.org_id = cd.org_id AND ps.id = cd.stage_id
  LEFT JOIN clients cl ON cl.org_id = cd.org_id AND cl.id = cd.client_id

  LEFT JOIN funding_rounds fr ON fr.org_id = e.org_id AND fr.client_id = e.client_id
       AND fr.round_number::text = e.payload->>'roundNumber'

contract.control: Funded amount prompt (window.prompt, up to 3 tries; blank or cancel abandons the move, never sends zero)
contract.requirement: A valid prompt submission must reach the round.funded receipt and equal the amount saved on that funding round.
contract.sql:
/* display-result:funded-prompt */
SELECT count(*)::int AS sample_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE fr.id IS NULL OR e.client_id IS NULL OR e.client_id IS DISTINCT FROM fr.client_id
         OR CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.payload->>'roundNumber', '') ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,8}$'
              THEN (e.payload->>'roundNumber')::int END IS DISTINCT FROM fr.round_number
         OR COALESCE(CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.payload->>'fundedAmount', '') ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
              THEN (e.payload->>'fundedAmount')::numeric END, 0) <= 0
         OR fr.funded_amount IS DISTINCT FROM CASE
              WHEN COALESCE(e.payload->>'fundedAmount', '') ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
              THEN (e.payload->>'fundedAmount')::numeric END)::int AS bad_count
  FROM events e
  LEFT JOIN funding_rounds fr ON fr.org_id = e.org_id AND fr.id::text = e.payload->>'fundingRoundId'
 WHERE e.org_id = $1::uuid AND e.name = 'round.funded'
   AND e.payload->>'source' = 'card_stacking'
   AND COALESCE(e.is_demo, false) = false
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clients rdc WHERE rdc.id = e.client_id AND COALESCE(rdc.is_demo, false) = true)

contract.requirement: A signed-out session must never be seen again after the moment it was revoked, so a sign-out really ends the session and the page-load check never lets a revoked token in.
contract.sql:
/* display-result:fin-b20-session */
SELECT count(*)::int AS sample_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.revoked_at < r.created_at
         OR EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.last_seen_at - r.revoked_at)) > 300)::int AS bad_count
  FROM (SELECT org_id, created_at, expires_at, revoked_at, last_seen_at FROM sessions
        UNION ALL
        SELECT org_id, created_at, expires_at, revoked_at, last_seen_at FROM account_sessions) r
 WHERE r.org_id = $1::uuid AND r.created_at > now() - interval '30 days'

contract.requirement: A saved company logo, and a partner's approved logo, must be an https address with no whitespace, quote, bracket or angle mark in it, or an inline data:image base64 value, or the chrome refuses to paint it.

/* display-result:fin-b19-brand-wordmark */
SELECT count(*)::int AS sample_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE regexp_replace(x.logo, '^https://[^\s"''<>()]+$', '', 'i') <> ''
         AND regexp_replace(x.logo, '^data:image/[a-zA-Z0-9.+-]+;base64,[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$', '', '') <> '')::int AS bad_count
  FROM (
    SELECT regexp_replace(b.wordmark_url, '^\s+|\s+$', '', 'g') AS logo

     WHERE b.org_id = $1::uuid AND b.wordmark_url IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT regexp_replace(pb.wordmark_url, '^\s+|\s+$', '', 'g') AS logo
      FROM partner_brand pb
     WHERE pb.org_id = $1::uuid AND pb.approval_status = 'approved' AND pb.wordmark_url IS NOT NULL
  ) x
 WHERE x.logo <> ''

/* display-result:repair-amount-paid */
SELECT count(*)::int AS sample_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.amount_paid IS NULL OR r.price_total IS NULL
         OR r.amount_paid < 0 OR r.price_total < 0
         OR r.amount_paid > r.price_total
         OR (r.program = 'trial' AND r.rounds_cap IS DISTINCT FROM 2)
         OR (r.program = 'full' AND r.rounds_cap IS DISTINCT FROM 6)
         OR ((r.created_at IS NULL OR r.created_at >= now() - interval '60 days') AND (
              (ROUND(r.price_total * 100) IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN r.program = 'trial' THEN 20000 ELSE 100000 END)
               AND NOT EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1 FROM sales s
                   JOIN products pr ON pr.org_id = s.org_id AND pr.id = s.product_id
                  WHERE s.org_id = r.org_id AND s.client_id = r.client_id AND pr.category = 'repair'
                    AND ROUND(s.agreed_price * 100) = ROUND(r.price_total * 100)))
              OR (ROUND(r.amount_paid * 100) > COALESCE(pl.cents, 0)
                  AND ROUND(r.amount_paid * 100) > COALESCE(sp.cents, 0))
              OR (r.amount_paid = 0 AND ROUND(r.price_total * 100) > 0 AND (
                    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(x.paid_amount_cents, x.amount_cents, 0)), 0)
                       FROM payment_links x
                      WHERE x.org_id = r.org_id AND x.client_id = r.client_id AND x.purpose = 'repair'
                        AND x.status = 'paid' AND (x.paid_at IS NULL OR x.paid_at <= r.created_at + interval '1 day')) >= ROUND(r.price_total * 100)
                    OR (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(y.amount * 100)), 0)
                          FROM sale_payments y
                          JOIN sales s2 ON s2.org_id = y.org_id AND s2.id = y.sale_id
                          JOIN products p2 ON p2.org_id = s2.org_id AND p2.id = s2.product_id AND p2.category = 'repair'
                         WHERE y.org_id = r.org_id AND s2.client_id = r.client_id
                           AND (y.paid_at IS NULL OR y.paid_at <= r.created_at + interval '1 day')) >= ROUND(r.price_total * 100)))
         )))::int AS bad_count
  FROM repair_programs r
  JOIN clients c ON c.org_id = r.org_id AND c.id = r.client_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT org_id, client_id, SUM(COALESCE(paid_amount_cents, amount_cents, 0)) AS cents
      FROM payment_links
     WHERE purpose = 'repair' AND status = 'paid'
     GROUP BY org_id, client_id) pl ON pl.org_id = r.org_id AND pl.client_id = r.client_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT s3.org_id AS org_id, s3.client_id AS client_id, SUM(ROUND(z.amount * 100)) AS cents
      FROM sale_payments z
      JOIN sales s3 ON s3.org_id = z.org_id AND s3.id = z.sale_id
      JOIN products p3 ON p3.org_id = s3.org_id AND p3.id = s3.product_id AND p3.category = 'repair'
     GROUP BY s3.org_id, s3.client_id) sp ON sp.org_id = r.org_id AND sp.client_id = r.client_id

/* display-result:fin-b07-business-fields */
SELECT count(*)::int AS sample_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE cl.id IS NULL
         OR NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(b.name, '')), '') IS NULL
         OR NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(b.entity_data->>'address_line1', '')), '') IS NULL
         OR NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(b.entity_data->>'city', '')), '') IS NULL
         OR NOT (length(COALESCE(b.entity_data->>'state', '')) = 2 AND translate(COALESCE(b.entity_data->>'state', ''), 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ', '') = '')
         OR NOT ((length(COALESCE(b.entity_data->>'postal_code', '')) IN (5, 9) AND translate(COALESCE(b.entity_data->>'postal_code', ''), '0123456789', '') = '')
                 OR (length(COALESCE(b.entity_data->>'postal_code', '')) = 10 AND substr(COALESCE(b.entity_data->>'postal_code', ''), 6, 1) IN ('-', ' ')
                     AND translate(substr(COALESCE(b.entity_data->>'postal_code', ''), 1, 5) || substr(COALESCE(b.entity_data->>'postal_code', ''), 7, 4), '0123456789', '') = ''))
         OR NOT (length(COALESCE(b.entity_data->>'ein', '')) = 10 AND substr(COALESCE(b.entity_data->>'ein', ''), 3, 1) = '-'
                 AND translate(substr(COALESCE(b.entity_data->>'ein', ''), 1, 2) || substr(COALESCE(b.entity_data->>'ein', ''), 4, 7), '0123456789', '') = '')
         OR b.age_months IS NULL OR b.age_months < 0
         OR CASE WHEN length(COALESCE(b.entity_data->>'incorporated_date', '')) >= 7 AND substr(b.entity_data->>'incorporated_date', 5, 1) = '-'
                      AND translate(substr(b.entity_data->>'incorporated_date', 1, 4) || substr(b.entity_data->>'incorporated_date', 6, 2), '0123456789', '') = ''
                 THEN CASE WHEN CAST(substr(b.entity_data->>'incorporated_date', 6, 2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 12
                           THEN ABS(COALESCE(b.age_months, 0)
                                    - ((CAST(substr(CAST(b.created_at AS text), 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(b.entity_data->>'incorporated_date', 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) * 12
                                       + (CAST(substr(CAST(b.created_at AS text), 6, 2) AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(b.entity_data->>'incorporated_date', 6, 2) AS INTEGER)))) > 1
                           ELSE true END
                 ELSE true END)::int AS bad_count
  FROM businesses b
  LEFT JOIN clients cl ON cl.org_id = b.org_id AND cl.id = b.client_id
 WHERE b.org_id = $1::uuid AND b.entity_data->>'source' = 'soft_pull_approve'

   AND b.created_at >= now() - interval '60 days'

         OR NOT EXISTS (

               WHERE pl.org_id = k.org_id AND pl.client_id = k.client_id

         OR EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM payment_links pl
               WHERE pl.org_id = k.org_id AND pl.client_id = k.client_id
                 AND pl.purpose = 'diagnostic' AND pl.status IN ('created', 'sent')
                 AND pl.amount_cents IS DISTINCT FROM 3200 + 1000 * (
                       SELECT count(*) FROM businesses b
                        WHERE b.org_id = k.org_id AND b.client_id = k.client_id
                          AND b.entity_data->>'source' = 'soft_pull_approve'))
         OR NOT EXISTS (

 WHERE k.org_id = $1::uuid AND k.kind = 'soft_pull_consent'
   AND k.granted_by_kind = 'client' AND k.capture_method = 'typed'

contract.requirement: Every person-to-person chat thread must have no client, exactly two staff of this company as participants, a pair key made of those two ids, and only internal notes sent by one of the two.
contract.sql:
/* display-result:fin-b20-chat-peer */
SELECT count(*)::int AS sample_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.client_id IS NOT NULL
         OR c.internal_pair_key IS NULL
         OR COALESCE(p.n_parts, 0) <> 2
         OR COALESCE(p.n_foreign, 0) > 0
         OR (COALESCE(p.n_parts, 0) = 2
             AND c.internal_pair_key NOT IN (p.lo || ':' || p.hi, p.hi || ':' || p.lo))
         OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages m
                     WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id
                       AND (m.channel <> 'internal' OR m.sender_kind <> 'staff' OR m.sender_staff_id IS NULL
                            OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conversation_participants x
                                            WHERE x.conversation_id = c.id AND x.staff_id = m.sender_staff_id))))::int AS bad_count
  FROM conversations c
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT cp.conversation_id,
                    count(*) AS n_parts,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.id IS NULL OR s.org_id <> $1::uuid) AS n_foreign,
                    MIN(cp.staff_id::text) AS lo,
                    MAX(cp.staff_id::text) AS hi
               FROM conversation_participants cp
               JOIN conversations c0 ON c0.id = cp.conversation_id AND c0.org_id = $1::uuid AND c0.kind = 'internal'
               LEFT JOIN staff s ON s.id = cp.staff_id
              GROUP BY cp.conversation_id) p ON p.conversation_id = c.id
 WHERE c.org_id = $1::uuid AND c.kind = 'internal' AND COALESCE(c.is_demo, false) = false
   AND COALESCE(c.last_pulse_at, c.created_at) > now() - interval '60 days'

/* display-result:careers-apply */
SELECT count(*)::int AS sample_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.bad = 1)::int AS bad_count
  FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM candidates c WHERE c.id = a.candidate_id AND c.org_id = a.org_id))
                OR (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tasks t WHERE t.org_id = a.org_id AND t.source_workflow = 'hiring-new-application' AND t.body = 'hiring:applied:' || a.id::text))
                OR (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM candidate_outreach o WHERE o.org_id = a.org_id AND o.application_id = a.id)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bad
      FROM candidate_applications a
     WHERE a.org_id = $1::uuid AND a.external_application_id IS NULL AND a.applied_at >= now() - interval '30 day' AND a.applied_at < now() - interval '1 hour'
  ) r

items.proofAsserts: Commas payment receipts. Verifies HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body (header x-webhook-signature, fallback x-commas-signature, secret COMMAS_WEBHOOK_SECRET; a second key SIM_WEBHOOK_SECRET is accepted only for bodies marked simulated). Writes the exact bytes to commas_inbox and answers 200 at once (Commas never retries); the Netlify commas-inbox-sweeper and the Inngest commas-inbox-drain then turn it into events and the money chain.
items.expected: door honors HMAC-SHA256 hex over raw body

items.proofAsserts: ClickFunnels leads, survey answers and bookings. Verifies HMAC-SHA256 of `<timestamp>.<rawBody>` (headers X-Webhook-ClickFunnels-Signature and -Timestamp, within 600 seconds; legacy x-clickfunnels-signature without a timestamp; secret CLICKFUNNELS_WEBHOOK_SECRET; CLICKFUNNELS_APPLY_SURVEY_INGEST_SECRET is a second accepted secret for the apply survey). Emits entry.captured, survey.submitted and booking events; updates bookings and tasks; keeps a raw copy only when CF_CAPTURE_MODE=1.
items.expected: door honors HMAC-SHA256 hex over timestamp.rawBody

items.proofAsserts: Bland AI call results (the setter and the bureau callers). Verifies HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body, hex (header x-bland-signature, secret BLAND_WEBHOOK_SECRET). Finds the call by id in outbound_calls and emits the call event. A not-yet-completed call answers ignored.
items.expected: door honors HMAC-SHA256 hex over raw body

items.proofAsserts: Lendflow alt-fin stage changes.
